title: The Gift We Couldn't Guess

Include subtle Ethiopian home details such as handwoven cotton textiles with tibeb borders and a jebena coffee set where appropriate. Keep faces non-identifiable. Avoid caricature, generic pan-African motifs, flags, and unrequested religious symbols. No generated text or lettering in images.
